slides.title: LITHIUM
rules: THE SCENE
A lithium refinery deep in rural Mexico, under the Sierra Mountains, turned into a warzone.
LOOK AT
The turquoise pools and the smoke rising out of the open pit.

slides.title: NYC
rules: THE SCENE
A wintry night in the thick of downtown, with a big stage in the center.
LOOK AT
Neon billboards glowing through the fog on the wet street.

slides.title: SENTRY
rules: THE SCENE
An assault on a Russian military base in whiteout conditions.
LOOK AT
Snow piling up on the armored vehicle, the roofs and the trucks.

slides.title: MUMBAI
rules: THE SCENE
A fugitive's hideout in a dense residential district around a Victorian market.
LOOK AT
The pink-stained street, blue tarps and the light in the alley.

slides.title: REACTOR U92
rules: THE SCENE
A South Korean reactor complex in meltdown, with a boiling containment pool.
LOOK AT
The blue glow of the pool lighting up the whole room.

slides.title: X01
rules: THE SCENE
A former GRANIT Arms black site on the edge of Hajin, seized by enemy forces.
LOOK AT
Thick fog and the light breaking through behind the squad.
